entities.summary: Snowy Shaw (b. 1968-07-25, Gothenburg) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Gothenburg and Sweden. Known in the fields of sweden, composers & musicians, europe.
